description: Catalog of standard legal document templates sourced from Common Paper. Each template lives in the templates/ directory and can be copied and modified under the CC BY 4.0 license.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Standard Terms for a mutual NDA allowing each party to disclose and protect confidential information for a defined purpose. Sourced from the Common Paper Mutual-NDA repository.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Fill-in Cover Page that incorporates the Mutual NDA Standard Terms by reference to complete an executed agreement. Sourced from the Common Paper Mutual-NDA repository.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms governing access to and use of a cloud/SaaS service, including support, user accounts, fees, and data handling. Sourced from the Common Paper CSA repository.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for giving early design partners access to a product in exchange for feedback used to develop and improve the product. Sourced from the Common Paper Design-Partner-Agreement repository.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms defining uptime targets, availability calculations, and service credit remedies for a cloud service. Sourced from the Common Paper SLA repository.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for delivering professional services under statements of work, covering cooperation, change orders, and payment. Sourced from the Common Paper PSA repository.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Terms addressing controller/processor relationships and the processing of personal data in compliance with data protection law. Sourced from the Common Paper DPA repository.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms licensing software for installation and use, including user accounts, feedback, usage data, and permitted uses. Sourced from the Common Paper Software-License-Agreement repository.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a business partnership covering each party's obligations, feedback, payment, and taxes. Sourced from the Common Paper Partnership-Agreement repository.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Terms granting a customer limited access to a product for evaluation purposes during a defined pilot period. Sourced from the Common Paper Pilot-Agreement repository.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA-oriented terms governing a business associate's use, disclosure, and safeguarding of protected health information (PHI). Sourced from the Common Paper BAA repository.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum supplementing an agreement to cover AI services, including input/output handling, usage restrictions, and model training. Sourced from the Common Paper AI-Addendum repository.
